description: Check Environment Agency Flood Map for Planning Flood Zones 2/3 at an England point. Tests polygon containment, ignoring defences; not a live flood warning or a site-specific flood risk assessment. No match is not a formal Zone 1 determination. Returns source data and provenance; supported hydrological units are normalised to SI. TerraMCP is a Wrench AI service. Open data: no API key or signup required. Anonymous limits: 60 calls/hour and 300/day per IP and session; keys offer higher limits, with anonymous fallback after monthly quota. Source licence warnings apply.

lat.description: Confirmed WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees; pair with lon.

lon.description: Confirmed WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees; pair with lat.

name: flood_zone_at_point
